purpose: Identify image-supported common pavement ROI and compare replayed raw pointmaps and the E1 final map, without claiming a cause
tracking: OpenCV pyramidal Lucas-Kanade over every intermediate input frame, both directions
holdout: spatially interleaved 20-pixel source-image grid tiles; even parity fit, odd parity evaluate, then swap
sim3: least-squares isotropic similarity from one raw pointmap to the other; fitted alignment removes a global rigid/scale difference and cannot assess original world placement
e1_map: sample original exported KF/pixel XYZ using provenance and independently selected correspondences; no additional alignment
limitations: textureless areas cannot be verified by optical flow; overlap and plane assumptions need image review; no metric scale
